meta.title: Echoes of Aethermoor
meta.tagline: Wield the elements. Forge your legend. Shape the world itself.
meta.description: Echoes of Aethermoor is a persistent fantasy MMORPG set on the fractured continent of Aethermoor — a land torn apart by the Sundering, a cataclysmic event where the eight primordial Elements tore free from the world's core. Centuries later, the land has healed into wildly different biomes, each infused with elemental energy. Players are Weavers — rare individuals who can channel raw elemental power through ancient Resonance Glyphs found in dungeons, ruins, and the wild. There are no fixed classes; your abilities are defined by which elements you attune, which glyphs you equip, and how you combine them. A fire-weaving berserker can become a frost-wielding tank overnight by swapping glyphs. The world is designed for deep exploration, punishing dungeon encounters, meaningful crafting, and a player-driven economy that shapes server-wide events.

mounts_vehicles.name: Windsprint Stag
mounts_vehicles.description: Graceful antlered mount native to the Verdant Cradle. Unlocks double-jump while mounted.

mounts_vehicles.name: Cinderback Drake
mounts_vehicles.description: A small drake bred for flight. Can glide but not truly fly indefinitely. Found in the Shattered Peaks.

mounts_vehicles.name: Tidecaller Turtle
mounts_vehicles.description: Massive sea turtle mount for ocean traversal. Can dive to underwater ruins.

mounts_vehicles.name: Ironclad Beetle
mounts_vehicles.description: Armored insect mount for the Molten Expanse. Resistant to lava damage.

mounts_vehicles.name: Crystalwing Hawk
mounts_vehicles.description: Rare mount from the Crystal Hollows. Glows faintly, illuminating dark areas.

weapon_categories.name: Greatswords
weapon_categories.description: Two-handed blades with wide sweeping attacks. High damage, cleave potential.

weapon_categories.name: Dual Daggers
weapon_categories.description: Fast-hitting combo weapons. Apply bleeds and exploit openings.

weapon_categories.name: Warhammers
weapon_categories.description: Massive impact weapons. Stagger enemies and shatter armor.

weapon_categories.name: Longbows
weapon_categories.description: Precision ranged weapons. Charged shots deal massive single-target damage.

weapon_categories.name: Resonance Staves
weapon_categories.description: Channeling weapons for elemental magic. Amplify glyph power.

weapon_categories.name: Runed Tomes
weapon_categories.description: Off-hand casting implements. Buff allies and debuff enemies.

weapon_categories.name: Spears
weapon_categories.description: Versatile reach weapons. Good for both thrusting and sweeping.

weapon_categories.name: Twinblades
weapon_categories.description: Circular bladed weapons. Constant spin attacks create a whirlwind of steel.

status_effects.name: Ignite
status_effects.effect: Burns target dealing fire damage over 8 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

status_effects.name: Frostbite
status_effects.effect: Slows movement by 30% and attack speed by 15%. At 3 stacks, roots target in ice.

status_effects.name: Overcharge
status_effects.effect: Target crackles with electricity. Next hit on them chains lightning to nearby enemies.

status_effects.name: Petrify
status_effects.effect: Encases target in stone. Cannot move or act. Breaks on heavy damage.

status_effects.name: Entangle
status_effects.effect: Vines root target in place. Target can still attack but cannot move.

status_effects.name: Wither
status_effects.effect: Drains life force. Reduces healing received by 50% and deals shadow DoT.

status_effects.name: Consecrate
status_effects.effect: Blesses an area. Allies inside regenerate health. Undead take continuous damage.

status_effects.name: Arcane Flux
status_effects.effect: Unstable energy. Increases damage taken and dealt by 20%.

status_effects.name: Void Corruption
status_effects.effect: Reality fractures. Randomly teleports target short distances. Deals void damage over time.

status_effects.name: Bleed
status_effects.effect: Open wound dealing physical damage over time. Stacks increase tick rate.

status_effects.name: Stagger
status_effects.effect: Momentarily stunned. Interrupts current action. Build-up based on damage taken.

skill_trees.name: Elemental Affinity
skill_trees.description: Deepen your connection to each of the 8 elements. Unlock more powerful glyphs and combo reactions.

skill_trees.name: Combat Mastery
skill_trees.description: Improve weapon techniques, combo chains, dodge timing, and counter-attacks for each weapon type.

skill_trees.name: Survival Instinct
skill_trees.description: Enhance health, stamina, elemental resistance, and out-of-combat regeneration.

skill_trees.name: Crafting Expertise
skill_trees.description: Unlock advanced recipes, improve crafting speed, bonus stats on crafted items.

skill_trees.name: Explorer's Path
skill_trees.description: Faster movement, reduced fall damage, improved gathering, hidden path detection.

currencies.name: Resonance Coins
currencies.description: Earned through achievements and world events. Cosmetics and convenience.

currencies.name: Faction Tokens
currencies.description: Earned from faction tasks. Used for faction gear and recipes.

custom_mechanics.name: Elemental Resonance Combos
custom_mechanics.description: When two or more elements overlap on a target, they create a Resonance Reaction — powerful emergent effects rewarding coordination.
rules: Fire + Ice = Steam Cloud: 5m fog zone blinding enemies, -40% accuracy.
Lightning + Water = Electrified Pool: Stuns enemies standing in water.
Earth + Fire = Magma Pool: Ground melts into lava, heavy fire AoE.
Nature + Holy = Overgrowth: Healing vines create a safe zone.
Shadow + Void = Reality Tear: Rift pulls enemies inward dealing void damage.
Arcane + any element = Amplify: Doubles effect and duration.
interactions: Reactions can chain: Steam Cloud + Lightning = Thundercloud strikes.
Dungeons require specific reactions to solve elemental puzzles.
Boss phase transitions triggered by elemental reactions.

custom_mechanics.name: Glyph Attunement System
custom_mechanics.description: Players equip Resonance Glyphs defining abilities. Equipping multiple same-element glyphs unlocks Deep Attunement ultimates.
rules: Up to 4 active glyphs and 2 passive glyphs equipped.
Mono-element builds unlock Deep Attunement ultimate.
Hybrid builds unlock Resonance Combos but no ultimate.
interactions: Swap glyphs at rest points freely.
Some puzzles require specific glyph combos.
Guilds pool glyphs for territory control.

custom_mechanics.name: Dynamic World Shaping
custom_mechanics.description: Player actions permanently alter server-wide world state. Defeating world bosses changes biomes. Ignoring threats spreads corruption.
rules: Each server has unique world state from collective choices.
Void rifts ignored = zones corrupted with tougher enemies, better loot.
Guilds organize raids to push back corruption and restore zones.
Seasonal world bosses rotating element types.
interactions: Corrupted zones have exclusive crafting materials.
Purified zones unlock rare merchants with exclusive recipes.
Visit other servers for different world states.

environments.name: Verdant Cradle
environments.visual_description: An ancient sprawling forest where massive trees form a living cathedral of green. Bioluminescent flowers and mosses cast soft blue-green glows along the forest floor. Canopy walkways and rope bridges connect treetop settlements. Sunlight filters through in golden shafts. Waterfalls cascade from elevated root systems. The air shimmers with motes of nature-element energy. Color palette: deep emerald, gold, soft blue, warm brown, violet.
environments.audio_mood: Gentle wind through ancient canopy, distant bird calls with magical reverb, soft bubbling streams, chime of crystal wind catchers.

sub_areas.name: Elderwood Grove
sub_areas.description: Heart of the forest where the World Tree's roots breach the surface. NPC capital city with markets, guild halls, and Elemental Academy.

sub_areas.name: Mosshollow Expanse
sub_areas.description: Marshy forest floor with giant mushrooms and spore clouds. Hostile fungal creatures and rare herbalism nodes.

sub_areas.name: Canopy District
sub_areas.description: Elevated treetop pathways. Ranger outposts, glider launch points, hidden elven shrines.

sub_areas.name: Rootmaze Caverns
sub_areas.description: Underground network beneath World Tree roots. Twisting tunnels with nature-aligned enemies and hidden glyphs.

ambiance.lighting: Dappled sunlight, bioluminescent glow at night
ambiance.fog: Light morning mist, thick spore fog in Mosshollow
ambiance.particles: Pollen motes, nature wisps, falling leaves
ambiance.sky: Warm blue through canopy gaps, stars at night

environments.name: Molten Expanse
environments.visual_description: A vast volcanic wasteland with rivers of magma carving channels through obsidian fields. Jagged volcanic peaks belch smoke into a perpetually orange-red sky. The ground glows with heat cracks pulsing like veins of fire. Dwarven forge-cities built into mountainsides. Lava lakes bubble and pop. Massive fire elementals roam as world-scale creatures. Color palette: deep red, burnt orange, obsidian black, molten gold, ash grey.
environments.audio_mood: Deep rumbling earth tremors, hissing steam vents, clanging dwarven forges, crackling fires, booming fire elemental footsteps.

sub_areas.name: Forgeheart Citadel
sub_areas.description: Dwarven stronghold inside a dormant caldera. Largest crafting hub. Grand Auction House.

sub_areas.name: Obsidian Fields
sub_areas.description: Flat plains of volcanic glass reflecting the sky. Fast aggressive enemies. Excellent mining.

sub_areas.name: The Crucible
sub_areas.description: Massive lava lake with stepping stones. Jumping puzzle leading to hidden fire-glyph shrines.

sub_areas.name: Emberpeak Summit
sub_areas.description: Highest volcanic peak. World boss encounter site. Perpetual ember-storms and lightning.

ambiance.lighting: Perpetual warm orange-red glow from magma
ambiance.sky: Perpetual orange-red, dim red sun through smoke

environments.name: Crystal Hollows
environments.visual_description: Enormous underground caverns where arcane energy crystallized into massive formations of every color. Towering crystal spires refract ambient magical light creating an ever-shifting kaleidoscope. The ground chimes when walked upon. Underground crystal lakes so clear they are nearly invisible. Floating crystal islands drift through the largest chambers. Architecture built from shaped crystal — transparent walls and prismatic roofs. Color palette: prismatic — violet, teal, magenta, soft gold, ice-blue.
environments.audio_mood: Soft crystalline chimes, harmonic hum of arcane energy, echoing water drips, musical tones when crystals are touched, whisper-hiss of arcane currents.

sub_areas.name: Prismata Academy
sub_areas.description: Arcane scholar's capital. Crystal towers and light-bridges. Best enchanting and runecrafting facilities.

sub_areas.name: The Shimmerdeep
sub_areas.description: Lowest caverns. Wild uncontrolled crystal growth. Hostile crystal golems guard rare veins.

sub_areas.name: Refractive Maze
sub_areas.description: Crystal wall labyrinth redirecting light beams. Puzzle area requiring arcane-glyph manipulation.

sub_areas.name: The Resonance Chamber
sub_areas.description: Natural amphitheater of harmonic crystals. Arcane world boss. The room itself fires crystal beams.

ambiance.lighting: All illumination from crystals — shifting prismatic colors, strong bloom
ambiance.particles: Sparkling crystal dust motes, prismatic light fragments
ambiance.sky: Cavern ceiling covered in crystal formations like a starfield

environments.name: Shattered Peaks
environments.visual_description: A colossal mountain range shattered during the Sundering — peaks literally float at various heights separated by yawning chasms. Snow covers upper reaches, lower valleys are windswept barren rock. Frozen waterfalls connect floating peaks like glass bridges. Lightning constantly arcs between highest points. Ancient temples carved into cliff faces accessible by glider or grapple. At the center floats the Shattered Heart — a massive inverted mountain. Color palette: ice white, slate grey, electric blue, deep indigo, pale violet.
environments.audio_mood: Howling mountain winds, cracking ice, distant thunder, screech of sky-drakes, deep bass hum of the Shattered Heart's void.

sub_areas.name: Skyreach Bastion
sub_areas.description: Fortress city on the largest peak cluster. Windrunner faction HQ. Glider racing league. PvP tournament arena.

sub_areas.name: The Frostbound Sanctum
sub_areas.description: Ancient ice temple frozen in time. Ice-puzzle dungeon with mirror-reflect mechanics.

sub_areas.name: Drake's Roost
sub_areas.description: Massive sky-drake nesting grounds. Taming challenges for air mounts. Extremely dangerous.

sub_areas.name: The Shattered Heart
sub_areas.description: Inverted floating mountain. Game's hardest platforming dungeon and void-element world boss.

ambiance.lighting: Cold blue-white daylight, lightning stroboscopic at peaks, aurora at night
ambiance.fog: Thick cloud banks at mid-altitude, blinding blizzards
ambiance.particles: Snow flurries, ice crystals, lightning sparks, cloud wisps at eye level
ambiance.sky: Floating peaks above, stormy purple-grey at peaks, vivid stars at altitude

environments.name: The Sunken Depths
environments.visual_description: A vast underwater realm of drowned cities, building-sized kelp forests, and bioluminescent creatures drifting through dark water. Ancient elven ruins encrusted with coral sit at mid-water level. Massive sea creatures patrol deep trenches. Shallow areas have crystal clear sunlight beams. Deep trenches are pitch black except for eerie bioluminescent glow. Air pockets exist in ancient domed structures. Color palette: deep navy, teal, bioluminescent cyan-green, coral pink, abyssal black.
environments.audio_mood: Muffled underwater acoustics, distant whale-song, creaking ancient structures, gentle current, eerie silence of deep trenches broken by bass rumbles from unseen leviathans.

sub_areas.name: Coral Citadel
sub_areas.description: Main underwater settlement in a massive coral dome. Air-filled. Tidal Forge for water-element gear.

sub_areas.name: Kelp Labyrinth
sub_areas.description: Dense kelp forest maze. Low visibility. Hostile creatures ambush. Hidden tide-pool fishing nodes.

sub_areas.name: Drowned Palaces
sub_areas.description: Sunken elven city. Ballrooms with floating debris, throne rooms overtaken by coral, lore libraries.

sub_areas.name: The Abyssal Trench
sub_areas.description: Deepest point in the game. Near-total darkness. Home to the Abyssal Leviathan world boss.

ambiance.lighting: Sunbeams in shallow water, bioluminescent glow in deep areas, arcane lantern sphere
ambiance.fog: Particulate haze by distance, murky near sediment
ambiance.particles: Floating debris, rising bubbles, bioluminescent sparkles
ambiance.sky: Bright surface glow fading with depth, liquid glass ceiling from air pockets

dungeons.name: The Hollow Heart
dungeons.visual_description: Deep in the Verdant Cradle's roots, corruption has taken hold. Descend through twisted roots into a cavern where a massive corrupted World Tree heart beats with dark purple energy. Walls pulse with sickly veins. Spore clouds everywhere.

boss_encounters.name: Sporemother Yivara
boss_encounters.description: Colossal fungal queen fused with World Tree roots. Body is a living mushroom colony.
mechanics: Spawns explosive fungal adds every 30s
Persistent toxic spore clouds
50% HP immune shield broken by killing adds
Root grab pulls random player to melee

boss_encounters.name: The Rotweaver
boss_encounters.description: Corrupted druid guardian wielding decay magic and thorn walls.
mechanics: Shifting thorn wall mazes every 20s
Corruption pools spread if not cleansed
Drains life from environment — destroy roots to stop
8-minute enrage timer

puzzles: Purify corrupted root nodes in sequence
Nature glyph puzzle to open sealed doors

dungeons.name: The Forge Eternal
dungeons.visual_description: Ancient dwarven forge-complex in a volcano's heart. Air shimmers with heat. Metal glows. Lava flows through floor channels. Massive hammers powered by bound fire elementals. Descend toward the magma core.

boss_encounters.name: Forgemaster Cinderveil
boss_encounters.description: Mad dwarven blacksmith wielding a massive enchanted hammer, summoning fire constructs.
mechanics: Ground slam creates expanding magma fissures
Fire constructs must be kited into water
Invulnerable forge phase — destroy the anvil
Enrages gaining fire damage to all attacks

boss_encounters.name: Ignis Primordial
boss_encounters.description: A fire elemental the size of a cathedral. The entire arena IS its body.
mechanics: Arena floods with lava — reach elevated platforms
Hands slam platforms from lava
Fire breath sweeps in learnable patterns
25% arena shrinks — pure DPS race
Vulnerable to ice/water damage

puzzles: Reroute lava flows to cool pathways
Cool heated doors with ice glyphs

dungeons.name: Resonance Fracture
dungeons.visual_description: Crystal Hollows' deepest chamber where arcane energy fractured reality. Exists in multiple overlapping dimensions. Platforms float in zero-gravity. Non-euclidean geometry — corridors loop, gravity shifts. Prismatic chaos everywhere.

boss_encounters.name: The Refracted Mind
boss_encounters.description: Ancient arcane intelligence shattered into multiple copies. Fight several simultaneously while finding the true form.
mechanics: 5 copies — only true form takes real damage
True form shifts every 45s with crystal pulse cue
30% all copies merge — final burn phase

boss_encounters.name: Chromatic Wyrm
boss_encounters.description: Crystalline dragon cycling all 8 elements. Each phase changes abilities and weaknesses.
mechanics: Cycles all 8 elements every 60s
Wrong damage type heals it
Crystal pillars must be charged with matching elements
Final phase: random element every 10s
Drops legendary multi-element glyph

puzzles: Align crystal prisms to focus light beams
Navigate non-euclidean corridors with arcane compass
Bounce light through crystal to hidden switches

dungeons.name: The Drowned Oath
dungeons.visual_description: Massive sunken warship in The Sunken Depths. City-sized elven vessel encrusted with coral. Halls waterlogged with air in sealed chambers. Bioluminescent life everywhere. Deeper decks pitch black and flooded.

boss_encounters.name: Admiral Thalassian's Echo
boss_encounters.description: Ghost of the ship's elven admiral. Spectral sword techniques and ghost crew commands.
mechanics: Ghost crew adds must be killed by rank order
Tidal wave floods arena — reach elevated positions
Ghost ship phase: arena tilts, players slide
Strict timer from phase 2

boss_encounters.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
boss_encounters.description: Sea creature so vast its body IS the ocean floor. Eye larger than the arena.
mechanics: Tentacle attacks from ocean — dodge or grapple
Swallows ship — fight adds inside its mouth
Bioluminescent weak points on tentacles
Full surface breach — fight on its body
Drops legendary Abyssal Trident

puzzles: Operate ancient helm to navigate obstacles

dungeons.name: Void's Cradle
dungeons.visual_description: A rift in reality at the Shattered Heart's core. The void dimension bleeding into the material world. Physics breaks down. Floor is a mosaic of floating debris. Distant stars and impossible geometries. A throne room of broken reality.

boss_encounters.name: Vorthak, The Unraveler
boss_encounters.description: The void entity that caused the Sundering. Exists partially outside reality. 20-person raid.
mechanics: Reality phases: material/void plane alternation
Unraveling: randomly deletes one player ability for 30s
Void rifts must be closed by void-plane players
Gravity inversion every 90s
Memory wipe: all UI disappears for 15s
Final stand: all 20 channel for 10s while adds swarm
Server-wide event on defeat — permanently changes world state

traps: Reality tears teleporting to danger zones
puzzles: Material/void plane players align bridge segments

procedural_generation.description: Endgame 'Fracture Rifts' — randomly generated instances with scaling difficulty, random elemental affixes, unique loot. Seeded and shareable. Weekly hand-curated challenge rifts for leaderboards.

player.visual_description: Tall humanoid figures with an ethereal quality — faint elemental energy traces along their skin when abilities are used. Customizable body types, faces, and skin tones. Equipment visually changes appearance. Glyphs glow on equipped slots.

abilities.name: Elemental Bolt
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing damage based on equipped glyph element.

abilities.name: Resonance Burst
abilities.description: AoE pulse of equipped element around the player.

abilities.name: Elemental Shift
abilities.description: Instantly swap active glyph set. 10s cooldown prevents constant swapping in combat.

enemies.name: Corrupted Treant
enemies.description: Twisted tree creature animated by shadow corruption. Slow but hits hard.

enemies.name: Magma Crawler
enemies.description: Six-legged insect made of living lava. Fast and aggressive.

enemies.name: Crystal Wraith
enemies.description: Floating arcane entity made of shattered crystal fragments. Teleports and fires prismatic beams.

enemies.name: Abyssal Serpent
enemies.description: Massive sea serpent patrolling the Sunken Depths. Surfaces briefly to attack then submerges.

enemies.name: Void Revenant
enemies.description: A humanoid shadow that phases between reality and void. Appears and disappears unpredictably.

enemies.name: Ignis Primordial
enemies.description: A bound fire elemental the size of a cathedral. The forge itself is its body.

enemies.name: Abyssal Leviathan
enemies.description: A sea creature so vast its body forms the ocean floor. Eye larger than a building.

enemies.name: Vorthak, The Unraveler
enemies.description: The void entity responsible for the Sundering. Exists partially outside reality.

categories.name: Weapons
categories.description: All weapon types from greatswords to staves.

categories.name: Armor
categories.description: Protective gear across all armor types.

categories.name: Glyphs
categories.description: Resonance Glyphs that define player abilities.

categories.name: Consumables
categories.description: Potions, food buffs, and utility items.

categories.name: Crafting Materials
categories.description: Gathered and dropped materials for crafting.

enchanting_system.description: Enchant gear with elemental properties. Enchantments add visual effects and stat bonuses. Higher-tier enchantments risk failure and can destroy the item.

models_3d.name: World Tree
models_3d.description: Colossal tree trunk hundreds of feet wide with bioluminescent bark patterns. Roots extend like cathedral arches. Branches disappear into clouds above.

models_3d.name: Forge Eternal Hammer
models_3d.description: A hammer the size of a building, made of volcanic obsidian and glowing fire runes. The head constantly drips molten metal.

models_3d.name: Crystal Spire Set
models_3d.description: Collection of crystal formations from small shards to towering 100ft spires. Prismatic, translucent, internally lit.

models_3d.name: Floating Peak Fragment
models_3d.description: Section of mountain floating in mid-air with waterfalls cascading off edges into the void below. Snow-capped, rocky underside.

models_3d.name: Drowned Warship
models_3d.description: Massive elven warship encrusted with centuries of coral, barnacles, and bioluminescent sea life. Ornate elven carvings visible beneath growth.

models_3d.name: Resonance Glyph
models_3d.description: Floating circular glyph design with elemental symbols. Glows with element-colored energy. Hovers and slowly rotates.

models_3d.name: Aether Shard Currency
models_3d.description: Small crystalline shards that glow with internal light. Each one pulses with elemental energy.

textures.name: Barkskin Leather
textures.description: Natural leather texture with bark-like grain patterns. Green-brown tones with subtle magical glow veins.

textures.name: Obsidian Plate
textures.description: Polished volcanic glass surface — mirror-black with orange-red fire cracks visible through the material.

textures.name: Prismatic Crystal Surface
textures.description: Refractive crystalline surface that shifts color based on viewing angle. Internal fractures create rainbow patterns.

textures.name: Frost Iron
textures.description: Metallic surface with ice crystal formations growing from it. Pale blue-white with condensation frost.

textures.name: Void Corruption
textures.description: Corrupted surface — healthy material breaking down into purple-black void energy. Cracks leak dark particle effects.

animations.name: Elemental Cast — Fire
animations.description: Character channels fire energy — hands pull back with flame particles, then thrust forward releasing a fire bolt.

animations.name: Elemental Cast — Ice
animations.description: Character raises hand — frost crystals form in palm, then launches as an ice shard with frost trail.

animations.name: Glyph Swap
animations.description: Character holds hand up — equipped glyphs glow and orbit around hand — then snaps into new configuration with a flash.

animations.name: Glide — Hang Glider
animations.description: Character deploys arcane glider from back and spreads arms. Wind animates clothing and hair.

music.name: Verdant Cradle — Day
music.description: Soft orchestral with woodwinds, gentle strings, and ethereal harp arpeggios. Nature sounds woven in.

music.name: Molten Expanse — Combat
music.description: Heavy percussion, war drums, low brass stabs, distorted guitar riffs. Fire crackle undertones.

music.name: Crystal Hollows — Ambient
music.description: Ambient pads with crystalline bell tones, gentle reverb, and harmonic overtone singing.

music.name: Shattered Peaks — Summit
music.description: Full orchestral crescendo with choir. Sweeping strings over howling wind sound design.

music.name: Void's Cradle — Boss
music.description: Dissonant strings, reverse cymbals, distorted choir, deep sub-bass pulses. Reality-breaking sound design.

sfx.name: Glyph Activate
sfx.description: Crystalline chime with a rising tone and soft energy pulse.

sfx.name: Elemental Resonance Combo
sfx.description: Harmonic collision — two elemental sounds merge into a powerful harmonic chord with a shockwave bass hit.
sfx.trigger: Two elements combine for a Resonance Reaction

sfx.name: Lava Footstep
sfx.description: Heavy sizzling step with bubbling and heat hiss. Different from normal footsteps.
sfx.trigger: Walking on cooled lava in Molten Expanse

sfx.name: Crystal Chime Walk
sfx.description: Musical tinkling — each step produces a slightly different pitch from crystal shards underfoot.

ambient.name: Forest Depths
ambient.description: Layered bird calls, wind through leaves, distant waterfalls, occasional tree creak, insect hum.

ambient.name: Volcanic Rumble
ambient.description: Deep earth tremors, hissing steam, distant magma pops, crackling heat.

ambient.name: Underwater Silence
ambient.description: Muffled pressure, distant whale song, gentle current, bubbles rising.

voice.voice_description: Ancient, slow, resonant. Deep male voice with natural reverb as if speaking from inside a tree.
sample_lines: The roots remember what the branches have forgotten.
You seek the Glyph of Growth? Then prove you understand patience.

voice.voice_description: Raspy, intense female voice with metallic reverb and occasional crackle of fire.
sample_lines: The forge does not forgive weakness!
Let me show you true fire!

voice.voice_description: Dissonant multi-layered voice — sounds like three voices speaking slightly out of sync. Whisper and boom simultaneously.
sample_lines: Reality is a thread. I am the scissors.
Your existence is a rounding error.

vfx.name: Fireball Projectile
vfx.description: Swirling fire sphere with trailing embers. Core is white-hot, outer layer is orange-red with smoke trail.

vfx.name: Resonance Combo — Steam Cloud
vfx.description: Expanding white-grey fog cloud with crackling lightning inside. Condensation drips from edges.

vfx.name: Elemental Shift Effect
vfx.description: Character's equipped glyphs flash and orbit around them in a helix pattern before snapping to new positions.

vfx.name: Void Corruption Spread
vfx.description: Healthy ground cracks and purple-black void energy seeps through. Reality distortions ripple outward.

vfx.name: Mythic Drop Glow
vfx.description: Item on ground radiates golden light with pulsing beam shooting into the sky. Particle cascade around it.

quests.name: The Weaver's Awakening
quests.description: The player discovers their ability to channel elemental energy and receives their first Resonance Glyph.

steps.description: Find the shattered glyph in the ruins near Elderwood Grove.
Bring the glyph shard to the World Tree Keeper.
Attune to your first element at the Resonance Altar.
Test your new abilities on corrupted creatures in Mosshollow.

quests.name: The Forge Eternal Chain
quests.description: A multi-part quest chain leading to the Forge Eternal dungeon. Unlocks fire-glyph crafting.

steps.description: Investigate reports of missing dwarven miners near the Molten Expanse.
Rescue trapped miners from magma crawler nests.
Deliver forged key fragments to the Forgeheart Citadel elder.
Enter The Forge Eternal and defeat Forgemaster Cinderveil.

quests.name: Corrupted Roots
quests.description: Druids in the Verdant Cradle are losing control of their territory to spreading corruption.

steps.description: Collect corruption samples from infected areas.
Analyze them at the Elemental Academy.
Purify 5 corrupted root nodes using nature-glyph abilities.

quests.name: The Shattered Heart Descent
quests.description: Endgame quest chain culminating in the Void's Cradle raid. Reveals the truth behind the Sundering.

steps.description: Gather allies — speak to faction leaders across all 5 regions.
Collect Void Ward fragments from each region's world boss.
Assemble the Void Ward at the Shattered Heart.
Enter Void's Cradle and confront Vorthak.

world_events.name: Emberstorm Incursion
world_events.description: Fire elementals breach the surface near Forgeheart Citadel. All players in the zone must push them back.

world_events.name: Void Rift Emergence
world_events.description: A void rift opens in a random zone. If not closed within 30 minutes, the zone becomes corrupted for 24 hours.

world_events.name: The Grand Tournament
world_events.description: Monthly PvP tournament at Skyreach Bastion. 1v1 and 3v3 brackets with cosmetic rewards.

ui.style: Fantasy ornate with elemental themes. UI borders and frames change color based on player's dominant equipped element. Smooth transitions between states.

hud_elements.name: Health Globe
hud_elements.description: Circular health indicator with elemental glow. Pulses when low.

hud_elements.name: Mana Orb
hud_elements.description: Smaller orb next to health. Shows current mana pool. Color matches dominant element.

hud_elements.name: Stamina Bar
hud_elements.description: Horizontal bar under health/mana. Depletes on sprint, dodge, climb.

hud_elements.name: Glyph Bar
hud_elements.description: 4 active glyph slots showing equipped abilities with cooldown overlays.

hud_elements.name: Mini-map
hud_elements.description: Circular mini-map with elemental terrain coloring. Shows nearby enemies, quests, and party members.

hud_elements.name: Target Frame
hud_elements.description: Shows targeted enemy name, level, health bar, and elemental affinity icon.

hud_elements.name: Chat Window
hud_elements.description: Tabbed chat with General, Party, Guild, Trade, and System channels.

hud_elements.name: Buff/Debuff Bar
hud_elements.description: Active status effects with duration timers. Icons enlarge for important debuffs.

menus.name: Character Sheet
menus.description: Full character view with stats, equipped gear, glyph loadout, and appearance customization.

menus.name: Inventory
menus.description: Grid-based inventory with tabs for gear, consumables, materials, and glyphs. Drag-and-drop to equip.

menus.name: Glyph Codex
menus.description: Collection of all discovered glyphs. Shows element, abilities, and Resonance Combo interactions.

menus.name: World Map
menus.description: Full continent map showing regions, waypoints, dungeon entrances, and corruption status. Zoom to sub-area detail.

menus.name: Quest Journal
menus.description: Active and completed quests with progress tracking. Main story quests highlighted.

menus.name: Crafting Station
menus.description: Profession-specific crafting interface. Shows recipes, required materials, and skill level.

menus.name: Auction House
menus.description: Browse, search, buy, and sell items. Filter by category, rarity, price, and element.

menus.name: Guild Hall
menus.description: Guild roster, treasury, territory control map, and guild progression perks.

menus.name: Bestiary
menus.description: Encyclopedia of discovered enemies with lore, weakness info, drop tables, and kill counts.
